{{BossList|Default}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Shining Sword Stab}}''' - Impales the ground, solidifying nearby towers with golden crystals. |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Golden Summoning}}''' - The '''Gold Titan''' will yell and summon three to five [[24 Karat]]s at the entrance. |ability3 = '''{{WikiAb|Gilded Rain}}''' - Rains down golden fists marked with a red dot from the sky, solidifying any tower hit with golden crystals. |music-1 = '''Version 1''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Final Wave ORIGINAL|center|250px|thumb]] |music-2 = '''Version 2''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Fallen Boss|center|250px|thumb]] |music-3 = '''Current''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Gold Titan (Golden Boss)|center|250px|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Boss text here lol|Beginning of Wave 40 ([[Golden Mode|Golden]])}} {{QuoteBox|Great[sic] ready for a HUGE BOSS!|Beginning of Wave 60 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gold Titan''' was the third major boss to be added into the game and is the final boss in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode, which is exclusive to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. The '''Gold Titan''' walks quite slowly, slower than the [[Chained Boss]], but it has a high amount of health. It is immune to most splash damage and is a [[Boss]] enemy, granting it multiple full or partial stalling immunities and some damage immunities. Its sword is used to stun towers. With this sword it can stab the ground which would stun all towers in the nearby vicinity. It can spawn 3-5 [[24 Karat]]s at the start of the map, meaning that you need towers to tackle these enemies. The enemy can rain golden fists from the sky as well, making an explosion upon landing, solidifying towers. It could also smash the ground in one direction, solidifying all towers in that direction, though this no longer happens in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Appearance== The '''Gold Titan''' is made of golden blocks to create a robot-type [[Enemies|enemy]]. In its right hand, it wields a golden sword. It has a single rectangular eye in the middle of its head. It is much taller than most enemies. A golden aura pulsates out of its head. ==Strategy== *When using any of its attacks, the '''Gold Titan''' will become immobile. You should use that to your advantage. **If your towers are crystallized, you can sell them and replace them, if you want to. *Most splash damage towers, like the [[Rocketeer]], [[Mortar]] and [[Demoman]], are useless against the '''Gold Titan''' as they will deal no damage towards the '''Gold Titan''' and its summons. **There are still some sources of splash damage that can damage them. These include the [[Paintballer]], [[Hallow Punk]], [[Grenade]], [[AirStrike]] and [[Nuke]]. **Sell them and replace them with high DPS towers such as the [[Pursuit]], [[Turret]] or [[Accelerator]]. **Some towers, like the [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]], despite dealing splash damage, are useful against the '''Gold Titan''' as they can deal non-splash damage. *The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can help massively as they can boost the DPS of your towers. *Due to it being a [[Boss]] enemy, many forms of stalling are ineffective against it. **It cannot be frozen, but it can still be chilled by freezing towers. **It is only slowed down by stuns instead of being stunned. **Knockback, [[DJ Booth]] slowdown, [[Harvester]] slowdown and [[Toxic Gunner]] slowdown are completely unable to slow it down. **It also cannot be damaged by the [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseGoldTitan.png.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} GoldTitan.jpg|'''Gold Titan''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} EG0FmvFX4AAKYLS.jpg|'''Gold Titan''' on the game icon. GoldTitanIconIG.png|'''Gold Titan''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This was the third major boss to be added to the game, though if you count the [[Swordmaster]] as a major boss, this was the fourth to be added. *''Gilded Rain'' appears to rain down golden fists with a diamond shaped eye on them. This is weird considering that the '''Gold Titan''' appears to have no visible fingers. *The '''Gold Titan''' is a based on the [https://riskofrain2.wiki.gg/Aurelionite Aurelionite] from ''Risk of Rain 2''.[[File:GoldTitanAurelioniteProof.png|280px]]
https://discord.com/channels/587355301083349002/587355301674614854/607379123907592234 (Tower Defense Simulator Server) *A dead '''Gold Titan''' can be seen lying on the ground in [[Gilded Path]], with its sword next to it, likely representing the removal of [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''2 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.7|BETA v1.7.0]] **'''Gold Titan''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Gold Titan''' is prone to errors. *'''14 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.9|BETA v1.9.3]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Gold Titan''' is no longer prone to errors. *'''15 August 2019''' - [[BETA v1.10|BETA v1.10.0]] **'''Gold Titan''' now appears at wave 60 instead of wave 56. **Now has [[Freeze Immunity]]. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **First wave appearance changed from wave 60 to wave 40 in Hard mode (now [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode). **Health increased from 60,000 to 80,000. **''Gilded Rain'' attack added. **''Summon'' can now spawn [[24 Karat]]s. **New final wave music, [[Soundtrack|Fallen Boss]]. **Death animation removed. **Now is a [[Boss]] enemy. *'''11 February 2020''' - [[Release v1.7|Release v1.7.0]] **[[MEGA Servers|MEGA Health]] scaling added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0]] **'''Gold Titan''' removed. **'''NOTE''': While the '''Gold Titan''' was removed in the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], multiple changes were made to it, though they could never be seen in-game due to its removal. These are: ***Health increased from 80,000 to 100,000. ***[[Burn Immunity]] removed. ***Now has [[Energy Immunity]]. ***Summoned enemies no longer give money when damaged. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.4]] **'''Gold Titan''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode and appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. ***Due to changes made with updates, its [[Energy Immunity]] has been replaced with the [[Stun Immunity]]. **Death animation removed. **{{Bug}} '''Gold Titan''' does not use any of its abilities. **{{Bug}} '''Gold Titan''' cannot be highlighted. *'''17 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0|v1.46.5]] **'''Gold Titan''' can no longer be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0|v1.53.3a]] **'''Gold Titan''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode and appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Golden Mode|Golden]] mode. **''Golden Summoning'' summon count decreased from 5-8 to 3-5. **''Golden Summoning'' no longer summons [[Golden]]s. **{{Bugfix}} '''Gold Titan''' now uses its abilities, except ''Midas' Slash''. **{{Bug}} '''Gold Titan''' will sometimes freeze in place if it uses ''Shining Sword Stab''. }} ==Notes== {{Golden|[[24 Karat]]|Wave 39|Gold Titan & [[Gold Guard]]|Wave 40|End|N/A}} {{GoldenNuclear|[[24 Karat]]|Wave 39|Gold Titan & [[Gold Guard]]|Wave 40|End|N/A}} {{Hard|[[24 Karat]]|Wave 59|Gold Titan|Wave 60 (End of Hard Mode)|[[Frozen (Pre-MEGA)|Frozen]]|Wave 61}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
